pinev: Iowa bank across from Marcus, from the Dixon Evening Telegraph, 7 Feb 1903; cache spot not given

Lanark Gazette, the nearest indexed Carroll Co weekly: the robbery was the night of 5 Aug 1902, 6 mi N of Savanna; the Jan 1903 issue names one robber as Ed Estelle. More Lanark issues of 1903 are still to be read for any recovery.
